SY01.slogan: No model grades its own work. Verify. Then approve.

caption.kicker: No model grades its own work
caption.title: Verify. Then

SY01.alt: No model grades its own work: from snowy mountains a thread of work passes the author, then a separate independent reviewer, then a human approval, along a sunny shore with cypresses, and the line of value rises.

SY02.slogan: No model grades its own work.
SY02.alt: Two separate streams, the author and the independent reviewer, take turns over three revisions that get cleaner each round, across a calm lake toward a stone terrace where the line of value rises.

SY03.slogan: Verify. Then approve. A human decides.

caption.kicker: Model agreement is evidence, not approval
caption.title: Verify. Then

SY03.alt: A verified document reaches the human decision: a document sealed with a wax seal and signed with a fountain pen on a stone terrace above the sea; then the line of value rises.
